6.asc: [Black Book] Uranus: The intuitive intellect to recognize when absolute rigidity is essential but with innovative applications to lessen its severity [White Book] Uranus: (no description)
6.desc: [Black Book] Mercury: The dogmatic, principled and carefully reasoned understanding that is uncompromising in its severity and often coldly brutal in operation [White Book] Mercury: Expansive energy that cannot handle limitations.

1.name: Gate 61 Line 1 - Occult knowledge
1.asc: [Black Book] Neptune: A natural psychic awareness that empowers principles of universalization [White Book] Neptune: The pressure to know the mysteries through esoterics.
1.desc: [Black Book] Venus: Where a reliance on secret knowledge increasingly demands ascetic withdrawal and leads eventually to obscurity [White Book] Venus: Where the pressure can be so strong that one can eventually incapable of handling the exoteric realities.

2.name: Gate 61 Line 2 - Natural brilliance
2.asc: [Black Book] Moon: and so gifted by this position a far-reaching, a nourishing influence, free of guile and powerfully attractive [White Book] Moon: A gift for inspiration that is both superficial to others.
2.desc: [Black Book] Mars: That in early recognition of its influence becomes ego obsessed with maximizing its effects [White Book] Mars: (no description)

3.name: Gate 61 Line 3 - Interdependence
3.asc: [Black Book] Moon: The ability to establish relationships for the actualization of truths, and through their nurturing and protective power to ensure a stable environment in which they can continue to grow [White Book] Moon: A delusion that any inspiration deserves recognition.
3.desc: [Black Book] Mars: With an abundance of energy and in possession of a truth, the tendency to leave others behind or be crushed by their resistance [White Book] Mars: The pressure to know enhanced through collaboration.

4.name: Gate 61 Line 4 - Research
4.asc: [Black Book] Saturn: The capacity of concentration to explore the depths of inner truth and maximize its application to fundamental principles [White Book] Saturn: Impatience with others and the forsaking of relationships.
4.desc: [Black Book] Jupiter: Where the tendency to expansion and integration leads to involving others in the research and may end in a diversity of confusing applications [White Book] Jupiter: The pressure to know the fundamental principles.

5.name: Gate 61 Line 5 - Influence
5.asc: [Black Book] Saturn: The enlightened Father figure whose recognized wisdom and powerful assertion can mold a generation by its influence [White Book] Saturn: The illusion that collaboration will enhance inspiration.
5.desc: [Black Book] Mars: A tendency in power to want to enforce compliance to ensure lasting influence [White Book] Mars: The pressure to know that may result in influence and wisdom.

6.name: Gate 61 Line 6 - Appeal
6.asc: [Black Book] Pluto: The profound attunement to the collectivity that can lure the public to a truth [White Book] Pluto: The pressure in knowing to resent challenges and demands.
6.desc: [Black Book] Mars: A reliance on shop-worn cliches and slogans that may be new in their level of energy but inevitably fall on deaf ears [White Book] Mars: (no description)

1.name: Gate 62 Line 1 - Routine
1.asc: [Black Book] Neptune: The ability to transcend the boredom of routine through a rich and daring fantasy life [White Book] Neptune: The ability to organize the detail through fantasy.
1.desc: [Black Book] Mars: Rebellion and its enormous waste of energy [White Book] Mars: The need for expression which ignores the details.

2.name: Gate 62 Line 2 - Restraint
2.asc: [Black Book] Saturn: The innate restrictiveness and discipline to comply with and exalt restraint [White Book] Saturn: The discipline necessary for detail work.
2.desc: [Black Book] Mercury: The intellect stymied by severe restraints tends to anxiety and restlessness [White Book] Mercury: The expression of anxiety and restlessness when faced with detail work.

3.name: Gate 62 Line 3 - Discovery
3.asc: [Black Book] Uranus: A genius for the unusual. The ability to discover valuable information in detail work and to find innovative applications for this knowledge [White Book] Uranus: The unusual gift of finding and expressing valuable details.
3.desc: [Black Book] Venus: A dissatisfaction with the monotony of detail work, where what is missed may be of great importance and value [White Book] Venus: The expression of dissatisfaction and boredom in detail work.

4.name: Gate 62 Line 4 - Asceticism
4.asc: [Black Book] Venus: The perfected ascetic withdrawal in the pursuit of harmony and simplicity, where outside dangers do not exist, and there is time to pursue inner meaning in detail [White Book] Venus: Detail that can only be expressed after periods of isolation and reflection.
4.desc: [Black Book] Pluto: The urge to take action against established values that when restrained by circumstances, leads to withdrawal that waits for opportunity [White Book] Pluto: When the detail is organized, isolation as a strategy waiting for the right opportunity for expression.

5.name: Gate 62 Line 5 - Metamorphosis
5.asc: [Black Book] Moon: The reaching out to others to share, symbolized by the Moon's phases as it moves from darkness to eventually sharing fully its light [White Book] Moon: The understanding that only when the details are complete can action or expression be initiated.
5.desc: [Black Book] Neptune: A tendency in metamorphosis to seek acclaim through dramatic presentation [White Book] Neptune: When the details are organized the need for attention demands expression.

6.name: Gate 62 Line 6 - Self-discipline
6.asc: [Black Book] Saturn: A penny saved is a penny earned. Detail as the path to material success [White Book] Saturn: The understanding that material success depends on the expression of detail.
6.desc: [Black Book] Mercury: The skills but not the discipline to succeed [White Book] Mercury: The gift for, but not the discipline to do the necessary detail work to succeed.

1.name: Gate 63 Line 1 - Composure
1.asc: [Black Book] Sun: The quality of personality where achievement is accepted with equanimity and where continued development is allowed to take its natural course [White Book] Sun: Acceptance of achievement but doubt whether continued development will take place.
1.desc: [Black Book] Mars: The tendency in achievement to immediately seek new goals at the risk of destabilizing what has already been accomplished [White Book] Mars: The pressure in achievement to still doubt one's capabilities and to immediately seek new goals.

2.name: Gate 63 Line 2 - Structuring
2.asc: [Black Book] Jupiter: The establishing of a large framework through which achievement can be expanded and shared; compensating others for their contributions while maintaining control of direction [White Book] Jupiter: (no description)
2.desc: [Black Book] Uranus: Instability in achievement that when in positions of authority leads to arrogance and the desire to keep others away from the center of power [White Book] Uranus: Doubts that one can maintain ones program when interacting with others.

3.name: Gate 63 Line 3 - Continuance
3.asc: [Black Book] Jupiter: The dedication to the new beginning that insists on maintaining its achieved principles despite having to interact with those who have not attained such a state [White Book] Jupiter: (no description)
3.desc: [Black Book] Saturn: Success at any price [White Book] Saturn: The pressure to explore the doubt in detail as a foundation for eventual formulating.

4.name: Gate 63 Line 4 - Memory
4.asc: [Black Book] Mercury: The detailed accounting of the achievement process whose information base can prepare a new order for the future [White Book] Mercury: The pressure and risk to forget the details when the doubts have been answered.
4.desc: [Black Book] Mars: A willingness to forget in the glow of victory, with a possible price to be paid later [White Book] Mars: The understanding that doubts are necessary and of value.

5.name: Gate 63 Line 5 - Affirmation
5.asc: [Black Book] Sun: The authority and sincerity of purpose to pursue the same values in the new beginning that had allowed it to transcend the old [White Book] Sun: Doubting ones doubts despite understanding.
5.desc: [Black Book] Mars: A tendency in triumph to pay lip service to such values, and given such leadership, these values will be reduced to nothing more than empty rituals [White Book] Mars: The logic of leaving old doubts behind.

6.name: Gate 63 Line 6 - Nostalgia
6.asc: [Black Book] Jupiter: The good sense to avoid turning the previous struggle into an obsession [White Book] Jupiter: Logic and the potential obsession with old suspicions and doubt.
6.desc: [Black Book] Pluto: Revolutionary nostalgia [White Book] Pluto: The logic of leaving old doubts behind.

1.name: Gate 64 Line 1 - Conditions
1.asc: [Black Book] Venus: In penetrating to the center, the understanding that instills the necessary harmony to survive disorder [White Book] Venus: An urge to act when you think you've made sense of the confusion.
1.desc: [Black Book] Mars: The powerful temptation when having transition in sight, to hasty action [White Book] Mars: Inner development that can end the confusion over what makes sense.

2.name: Gate 64 Line 2 - Qualification
2.asc: [Black Book] Venus: An inner development which recognizes what qualities are essential for transcendence and the awareness that without them, action will fail [White Book] Venus: Getting lost in the confusion and burdening the psyche.
2.desc: [Black Book] Moon: Constantly in action, it wastes the very qualities and resources that it will need [White Book] Moon: (no description)

3.name: Gate 64 Line 3 - Overextension
3.asc: [Black Book] Saturn: The wisdom to recognize when one has not the necessary resources to complete transition. Such timely awareness may give it a chance to seek assistance [White Book] Saturn: (no description)
3.desc: [Black Book] Moon: The risk of a superficially confident personality that when transition collapses, there is no one to turn to [White Book] Moon: The assuredness that confusion is a process that results in realization.

4.name: Gate 64 Line 4 - Conviction
4.asc: [Black Book] Moon: Symbolized by its phases, the Moon is assured of transition convinced by its very process that it will triumph [White Book] Moon: Where the confusion is so energized, assuredness brings no relief.
4.desc: [Black Book] Mars: Where force and energy alone cannot overcome doubt [White Book] Mars: Confusion over which values and relationships can bring harmony.

5.name: Gate 64 Line 5 - Promise
5.asc: [Black Book] Venus: The values promised in any new order are demonstrated through harmonic interactions with others. This strengthens the justification for the struggle [White Book] Venus: (no description)
5.desc: [Black Book] Jupiter: A tendency in trying to justify the struggle by focusing exclusively on the failure of the old order that cannot demonstrate the quality of the new [White Book] Jupiter: (no description)

6.name: Gate 64 Line 6 - Victory
6.asc: [Black Book] Mercury: The mental assuredness, that knew that victory was inevitable, thus making triumph sweet but not reason for excess [White Book] Mercury: (no description)
6.desc: [Black Book] Venus: Like the story of the Trojan Horse, it can be dangerous to get carried away in celebration, lest one loses vigilance and perspective [White Book] Venus: The pressure to share one's doubts with others while still maintaining control.
